name: ScrollGT flagship (Paris 4 20231210121321; train-exposed)
segment: 20231210121321 (2048² sub-crop of the ScrollGT v0.9.1 flagship region)
summary: ScrollGT (MIT, v0.9.1, commit 0f3fa90) ships a registered human ink label for this segment and calls it its held-out flagship. It is held out from ScrollGT's own baselines, but not from ours: 20231210121321 is ink_9um's phercparis4-w06, which is listed in the training configs embedded in Reader V3 and ink_9um seed42 (and dense_native). Input: level-2 (9.6 µm) surface volume, 4× z-pooled, layers 5-21; reference: ScrollGT's gt_ink.png binarised at > 127, cropped to the same box (examples/scrollgt/fetch_flagship.py). examples/scrollgt/ap_lift.py computes AP-prevalence-lift (ScrollGT's primary metric) on this crop. This segment is part of PHercParis4, so the scores (inkcheck numbers and AP-lift) are not published here while the publication reservation (until 2027-06-25) applies; only the verdicts are shown.
